description:
A fast, lightweight native desktop application for exploring, monitoring, and managing Kubernetes clusters.

Orbit is a lightweight, native desktop Kubernetes dashboard designed to provide a fast, responsive, and intuitive interface for managing Kubernetes clusters. Built with Rust and Tauri, Orbit ensures low memory footprint, snappy performance, and secure cluster interactions.
